Anti-gray hair serums `target hair follicles and scalp health to slow down premature greying and support natural melanin production without using traditional chemical hair dyes`.[[1]](https://www.particleformen.com/product/particle-anti-gray-serum/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZ-HELWSl-4/?hl=en)

- **Peptide Technology:** Ingredients like **Silverfree™**, **Greyverse™** , or the **Mela-9 Complex** act as biomimetic peptides to re-educate hair bulbs and stimulate the MC1-R receptor for natural pigmentation.[[1]](https://www.happyhead.com/products/anti-gray-serum)[[2]](https://www.particleformen.com/product/particle-anti-gray-serum/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:10536336828045278518,catalogid:4051259519561926625,gpcid:17660096862366322380,mid:576462892659123217&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://arey.com/products/to-the-root-serum)
- **Oxidative Stress Reduction:** Antioxidants and extracts like **Fo-Ti (He Shou Wu)**, **catalase** , or **blackseed and rosemary extracts** neutralize hydrogen peroxide buildup and free radicals in the follicle.[[1]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-ageless-anti-gray-hair-serum)[[2]](https://www.happyhead.com/products/anti-gray-serum)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NhzUgV83n74&t=8)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8252868934472291480,catalogid:6867810200219017133,gpcid:182560054886226275,mid:576462817028076473&ibp=oshop)
- **No Dye or Peroxide:** Unlike permanent or semi-permanent hair color, these formulas work gradually from the root during the natural hair growth cycle.[[1]](https://www.particleformen.com/product/particle-anti-gray-serum/)

### Popular Anti-Gray Hair Serums & Pricing

Around **$39** , formulated with Silverfree™ and Melitane for gradual reduction on light brown to black hair.[[1]](https://www.particleformen.com/product/particle-anti-gray-serum/)Around **$58 per month** , uses the Mela-9 complex and Fo-Ti to preserve and repigment strands.[[1]](https://arey.com/products/to-the-root-serum)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:10536336828045278518,catalogid:4051259519561926625,gpcid:17660096862366322380,mid:576462892659123217&ibp=oshop)Around **$78** (one-time), featuring peptides, Fo-Ti, and niacinamide best suited for hair with up to 30% gray.[[1]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-ageless-anti-gray-hair-serum)Around **$79 per month** , containing Silverfree™, Greyverse™, and Procapil®.[[1]](https://www.happyhead.com/products/anti-gray-serum)Around **$5 to $8 (369INR - 779INR)** , featuring 3% MelanoGray and rosemary/blackseed extracts.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8252868934472291480,catalogid:6867810200219017133,gpcid:182560054886226275,mid:576462817028076473&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12282549685184928944,catalogid:6111949161026498184,gpcid:15322437710541309211,mid:576462813459312343&ibp=oshop)Show more

### What to Keep in Mind

- **Timeline:** Results require consistent daily use over **3 to 6 months** , as they affect new growth rather than instantly transforming already white or silver hair.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZ-HELWSl-4/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.happyhead.com/products/anti-gray-serum)[[3]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-ageless-anti-gray-hair-serum)
- **Expectations:** Dermatological and medical reviews note that serums work best for premature or early greying rather than completely reversing age-related genetic greying.[[1]](https://www.today.com/health/skin-beauty/gray-hair-reversal-serums-rcna97961)[[2]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-ageless-anti-gray-hair-serum)
